name: init
summary: Create a validated implementation lane, or preview the plan with --dry-run.

flags.name: tmux-prefix
flags.description: Required tmux prefix: 1–16 lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.

flags.name: impl-pack
flags.description: Required existing implementation-pack directory, absolute or control-home-relative.

flags.name: coordinator-routing
flags.description: Required local version 1 coordinator routing policy JSON file.

flags.name: scope
flags.description: Optional schemaVersion 1 local repository bindings JSON file.

flags.name: runtime
flags.description: Installed compatible runtime version; required to apply, optional for --dry-run.

flags.name: update-gitignore
flags.description: Authorize init to add /.watchtower/ Git-ignore coverage, restored on a pre-commit failure.

flags.name: dry-run
flags.description: Render the complete preflight plan without creating directories, files, or links.
